author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
People wonder what junior engineers will do in the new AI era. 

Here is an idea

The senior engineers are busy writing skills to automate the dark factory running on the most expensive frontier models. 

The junior engineers take the skills, port them to run reliably on cheaper or open source models. 

Kind of like the good old team A, team B idea.  Team A builds a new product, team B adds incremental features and creates more cost efficient versions

comments.text:
Claude won't be offended if you ask it to translate its skills to run on cheaper model.

So unfortunately not sure that's the direction for juniors.

replies.text: JJ Marr Yeap. This kind of opportunity comes once every decade.  Let a junior leap frog a senior. But at some point, the stack will be more mature and the pace of change will slow down.
